model: five conditional relational dual-expert MLP members
sequence_score: ten-step causal mean of ensemble_mean_likelihood_ratio minus one ensemble standard deviation
threshold_origin: maximum ten-step robust-score window across 9 reserved DROID normal calibration episodes
finite_sample_statement: Under exchangeability, max-score split conformal with 9 episodes has nominal next-source-episode exceedance bound 1/(9+1)=0.10; no target-domain guarantee.

uncertainty_routing.model_low_support: report unknown/coverage; do not erase robust likelihood-ratio evidence and do not automatically emergency-stop

limitations: source calibration has only 9 normal sequence episodes
synthetic anomalies only scale response and do not span all real failure types
LIBERO-10 is opened diagnostic data and cannot validate a new primary claim
a new untouched target set is required after adapter and code hashes are frozen
